scope: Independent PostgreSQL effects and locking; no HTTP/Keycloak/browser campaign
checks: rollback removes trade receipt and position effects
discarded response and database restart replay have no duplicate effects
execution ID replay across orders denied
execution ID replay with changed quantity denied
execution ID replay with changed price denied
settle-first race preserves full fill and receipt
partial fill survives cancellation of remainder

findings.observation: Matcher SQL identity can overwrite order metadata through its existing UPDATE grant. Shared-lock cancellation prevents the ordinary application race only; it does not prevent a compromised writer from bypassing that path.

limitations: Discarded successful response models ambiguous delivery; no real network fault was injected.
Credential expiry and forged service tokens are covered by existing Java/HTTP campaigns, not re-proven here.
Mutation tests use the scoped matcher login against synthetic records; they do not demonstrate a real RCE.
No full-cluster, broker, operator UI or live identity-provider acceptance is claimed.
